title: Chris Coleridge (Associate Professor, Strategy & Entrepreneurship, University of Cambridge) recommends Incorruptible to his materials-scientist entrepreneurs
summary: Coleridge is an associate professor of strategy and entrepreneurship at the University of Cambridge and a fellow of Wolfson College. He taught a session on building a healthy company to 50 materials scientists on the Henry Royce Institute's Catalyst programme, and wrote that 21 years of teaching have moved him toward governance, where he points students to Incorruptible. 14 likes.
blockquote: Those who are especially interested in the latter subject may want to read Incorruptible, by Eric Ries.) I have had the misfortune to fall in with some low-integrity folks on my journey… and it’s caused me to focus hard on how to empower my students not to overlook the fundamental significance of proper, high-integrity governance as they build.
